name: WorldValueGenome
description: WorldValueGenome (ValueGenome) is a dataset designed to evaluate language models in reasoning about an individual’s value preferences in novel situations by learning from value-expressing statements from the same individual. It transforms 253 unstructured survey questions from the World Value Survey into 929 standardized natural language statements capturing the human value genome of 93K unique individuals worldwide.
reputation: A recent benchmark for value reasoning that is interesting for social and cultural alignment research, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on individualistic human value reasoning and alignment; uses real human survey data.
